career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risk is not AI but limited funded positions plus mixed qualification requirements. Roles are scarce and demand combined expertise, while interpersonal support remains hard to replace.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk in this occupation is limited funded positions plus mixed qualification requirements. Adapted physical education roles are scarce and often sit within special education or rehabilitation, while practitioners must understand both fields. One-on-one support and individualized plans remain difficult for AI to replace in the near term.
risks: Few funded positions, often attached to other programs
Difficult to span both education and rehabilitation
One-on-one work takes time and emotional energy

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how effective the tools become, teachers still judge whether a child is ready today, break activities into achievable steps, guard against hazards, and provide encouragement. Human observation, hands, and care cannot be removed from special education.

responsibilities: Lead training and provide physical support
Coordinate special education and rehabilitation services

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「编制有限 + 门槛杂」——岗少且要复合，但人际陪护难替。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「编制有限 + 门槛杂」——特教体育岗少、常挂靠在特教或康复里，且要跨教育康复两头懂；但一对一的陪护与方案短期难被 AI 替。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多好，那孩子今天状态行不行、怎么拆步才够得着、险情怎么护，最后还是老师的眼去看、手去扶、心去鼓励——特教这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is AI itself. Workers limited to scanning and payment face the highest risk; transition to multi-skilled service work offers a path forward.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk comes from self-checkout and cashierless retail. Customers now scan their own purchases, while self-checkout kiosks, cashierless convenience stores, and AI checkout replace Cashiers at scale. Pure cashier roles are contracting, and remaining jobs are shifting toward multi-skilled service work.
risks: Large-scale replacement by self-checkout and cashierless retail
Continued contraction of pure cashier roles
Accelerating automation and strong transition pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: Self-checkout scans for you, phones handle payment, and cashierless stores remove the register entirely. Machines are surrounding cashier roles, but people still provide the feeling of being served. Treat checkout as a springboard and learn service, equipment, and operations so automation does not leave you behind.

responsibilities: Collect payment, make change, and issue receipts
Maintain the register and reconcile funds

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险就是 AI 本身——只做扫码收钱最危险，转多技能服务岗才有活路。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险来自「自助收银与无人零售」：扫码枪变成了顾客自己扫，自助收银机、无人便利店、AI 结算正在大规模替代收银岗；纯收银岗数量在收缩，留下来的岗位也在向多技能服务岗转变。
risks: 自助收银与无人零售大规模替代
收入偏低，晋升空间有限
行业自动化加速，转型压力大

page.contract_project_risk_block: 自助机替你扫码、手机替你付款，无人店连收银台都省了——收银岗正在被机器围剿，但顾客要的「被服务感」，还得靠人。把收银当跳板，学会服务、设备、运营的本事，你就不会被机器甩下车。

responsibilities: 处理退换货与会员服务
维护收银台并盘点资金
skills: 自助收银设备引导维护

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but the combination of preparation being taken over and intensifying evaluations. People who only read prepared material face the earliest pressure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is not AI itself but having repetitive work taken over. Automated grading, reviews, and slide creation absorb routine teaching preparation, putting the most pressure on those who only read prepared material. Teachers who guide classes, supervise labs, and make research judgments remain valuable.
risks: Automated slide generation replaces manual work

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well AI creates slides, a person still has to identify why a student is stuck on coordination chemistry, supervise the experiment, and set the research direction. The human responsibility for guiding knowledge into understanding cannot be removed completely.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「准备被接管 + 考核卷」——只照本宣科的人最先被接走。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「重复被接管」——批改、综述与课件把常规教学准备接走，只照本宣科的人最承压；真正留下来的是能课堂引导、能带实验、能做科研判断的人。
risks: 课件自动生成替代人工

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管 AI 多能出课件，那个学生为啥卡在配位、实验怎么带、方向怎么定，还得人下讲台去引去定——育人这头，从知识到脑子的把关人撤不干净。

career_path_block.说明: Requires added customer-service and records skills
Manage both administrative matters and processes
Manage people and processes, reducing replacement risk

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is shrinking job counts. AI and automation absorb repetitive work, and clerks who do not broaden their functions face a narrowing market.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is overall contraction. Email automation, electronic tickets, and AI customer-service templates eliminate repetitive correspondence work. Correspondence-only positions are declining, while combined administrative, customer-service, and records roles remain.
risks: Job contraction: automation replaces correspondence processing
Low pay ceiling: entry-level clerk income is limited
High substitutability: training is short and labor supply is ample
Marginalization risk: single-function roles are easily consolidated
Outsourcing pressure: more administrative work is outsourced

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can answer standard letters instantly, but people still decide where a letter belongs and how to respond safely. Judgment and accountability remain human document skills. Use this for career exploration, not as a hiring or employment forecast.

responsibilities: Receive, register, classify, and route correspondence

career_risk_cards.callout: 通信文员最大的风险是「岗位数量在缩」——AI 和自动化吃掉重复劳动，不往复合职能走，饭碗会越来越窄。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「整体萎缩」——邮件自动化、电子工单、AI 客服模板让大量重复性信函处理消失，纯粹的通信文员岗位在减少，活下来的是会兼做行政、客服、档案的复合角色。
risks: 岗位收缩：信函处理被自动化替代
薪资天花板低：基础文员收入有限
替代性强：培养周期短、供给充足
边缘化风险：不兼职能容易被合并
外包冲击：行政事务外包比例上升

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能秒回标准信函，但「这封信该转给谁、怎么回才稳妥」——拿主意、担责任，是机器替不了的文书功夫。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are excess capacity and contracting positions. Pure polishing roles are disappearing as value shifts toward judgment and tone.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest career risks are excess content capacity and contracting positions, not AI alone. AI lowers the barrier to producing submissions, and traditional editorial headcount is falling. Editors with sound judgment and control of tone are becoming scarcer.
risks: AI generation is disrupting basic editing and proofreading
Excess content capacity is pushing down rates

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how well tools can write, people still choose topics, set tone, and answer for errors. Human accountability cannot be removed from content production.

hot_skills: Deep expertise in a specialized field

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「产能过剩 + 岗位收缩」——纯润色岗在消失，价值在向判断与调性集中。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「内容产能过剩 + 岗位收缩」——AI 生成拉低投稿门槛，传统编辑编制在减少，但会做判断和调性的人更稀缺。
risks: AI 生成冲击基础编校

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多能写，选题还是人定的、调性还是人把的、错还是人兜的——内容这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI alone, but smart monitoring combined with modeling. Routine inspections shift to systems, while strong investigators remain more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk to this career is not AI alone, but smart monitoring combined with digital modeling. IoT smoke detection and BIM models shift some routine inspections away from field staff. People still handle on-site judgment, fire-cause findings, and responsibility determinations.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how capable systems become, Fire Inspectors And Investigators still decide which hazards require remediation, where a fire started, and who is responsible. Fire prevention cannot remove people completely because human observation, judgment, and official accountability remain central.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「智能监测 + 建模」——常规巡检被外移，有调查力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「智能监测 + 数字建模」——物联网烟感与 BIM 建模把常规巡检部分外移，但现场判断、起火认定与责任判定仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪处隐患要整改、哪点起火、谁该负责，最后还是检查员的眼去查、脑去判、笔去定——防火这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks combine health and automation. Dust and noise harm workers, while machines absorb standard products.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risks combine dust and noise with automation. Long-term exposure requires occupational protection, while CNC and automatic polishing absorb many routine products. Manual work is shrinking, but custom finishing still depends on people.
risks: Tactile skill takes time to accumulate

page.contract_project_risk_block: Regardless of system sophistication, workers still choose abrasive fineness and control unusual curves. Human hands, eyes, and patient judgment remain essential to finished surfaces.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「健康 + 自动替代」——粉尘噪音伤身，标准件还被机器吃。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险是「噪音粉尘 + 自动替代」——长期接触粉尘噪音、职业健康需防护；同时数控与自动抛光吃大量常规件，纯手工在缩，但精修异形仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，那件异形弧度、该用多细的砂，最后还是工人的手去控、眼去看、心去磨——表面这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The biggest career risk is not AI, but "analytic automation + job merging" - the measurement records you make are being swallowed up by the system.
career_risk_cards.fact: The biggest risk for jobs is not AI, but "job merger + automated production line" - digital twins and MES take over part of the analysis, and pure measurement and recording jobs are being compressed.
risks: Digital twin and MES takeover analysis
The workshop environment is not suitable for some people

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how accurate the simulation is, why the production line is stuck, and whether the team is willing to implement it, in the end, people have to go to the site to see and promote it - on the efficiency side, the machine cannot be put to the ground.

skills: Working hours research and action analysis

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「分析自动化 + 岗位合并」——你做的测算记录正被系统吞掉。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「岗位合并 + 自动化产线」——数字孪生和 MES 接管部分分析，纯测算记录岗在被压缩。
risks: 数字孪生与 MES 接管部分分析
车间环境，部分人不适应

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管仿真多准，产线为什么卡、班组愿不愿执行，最后还得人去现场看、去推动——效率这头，机器落不了地。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but entering orders without exercising judgment. Catalogs will become digital, while only salespeople who understand vehicles, handle customer needs, and retain customers can withstand simultaneous channel and AI pressure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk is pressure from e-commerce and direct channels. Customers compare prices online and order directly through platforms, diverting traffic from traditional counters. AI is taking over catalog and inventory searches, reducing pure order-entry roles, while salespeople who understand vehicle models and handle fault inquiries remain more secure.
risks: E-commerce diverts traffic and pressures traditional counters
AI takes over catalog searches and reduces pure order-entry roles
Commission income fluctuates under high performance pressure
Holidays and weekends are busier, creating irregular rest
Vehicle models update quickly, creating knowledge-depreciation pressure

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can identify a compatible model in one second, but you are still needed to uncover the problem behind a customer's comment about squealing brakes and earn the trust behind the promise to return next time. Auto parts is a people business, and machines cannot replace what happens at the counter.

responsibilities: Receive customers and confirm parts needs
Search catalogs, verify fit, and quote prices
Enter orders, collect payment, and arrange shipping
Manage inventory and handle after-sales issues
skills: Quoting, order entry, and payment collection
Automotive repair fundamentals and fault knowledge

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「只会开单不会判断」——目录会电子化，懂车型、会处理需求、能留住客户的销售，才扛得住渠道和 AI 的双重挤压。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「电商与直连渠道挤压」——客户上网比价、平台直接下单，传统柜台客流被分流；而 AI 正在接管目录检索与库存查询，纯开单型销售被压缩，懂车型、会处理故障查询的销售更稳。
risks: 电商分流客流，传统柜台受挤压
AI 接管目录检索，纯开单岗压缩
提成收入波动，业绩压力大
节假日周末更忙，休息不规律
车型更新快，知识折旧压力大

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能一秒查出适配型号，但客户那句「刹车异响」里藏的问题、那句「下次还找你」的信任，还得靠你——汽配是「人」的生意，柜台前的事，机器替代不了。

responsibilities: 接待客户并确认配件需求
查询目录核对适配与报价

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but funding plus job availability. Permanent positions are shrinking and tools are absorbing cleaning work, while people with strong theoretical abilities become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but funding plus job availability. Permanent university and research positions are shrinking, while AI text analysis lowers barriers for some data-processing work. At the same time, practical applications are less direct than in business disciplines.
risks: Slow returns over a long career cycle

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, sociologists still use their minds to decide which questions matter, their writing to explain conclusions, and their voices to defend a position. People cannot be fully removed from research.

responsibilities: Conduct research according to methodological standards

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「经费 + 岗位」——编制收缩、清洗被工具吃，有理论力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「经费 + 岗位」——高校与科研编制收缩，且 AI 文本分析压低部分数据处理门槛；同时应用落地不如商科直接。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪个问题值得问、结论怎么解释、立场怎么摆，最后还是社会学家的脑去想、笔去写、嘴去辩——研究这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI but digital screening plus self-guided intervention. Initial screening moves outside counseling, while people with strong clinical skills become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest risk in this occupation is not AI but digital screening plus self-guided intervention. Apps and scales move some initial screening and follow-up outside counseling, while building trust, intervening in crises, and tailoring plans still rely on people.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent tools become, counselors still use their ears to listen, their empathy to connect, and their professional boundaries to determine which words to respond to, when a life requires urgent help, and which plan suits this person. People cannot be fully removed from psychological recovery.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「数字筛查 + 自助干预」——初筛被外移，有临床力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「数字化筛查 + 自助干预」——App 与量表把初筛和随访部分外移，但信任建立、危机干预与方案定制仍靠人。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管工具多聪明，哪句该接、哪刻要救、哪份计划适合这个人，最后还是咨询师的耳去听、心去共、手去守——重建这头，人撤不干净。

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risks are policy and electricity prices. Project returns follow subsidies and power prices, while people with strong delivery ability remain more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: The occupation's greatest risks are policy and electricity prices, not AI. Declining subsidies and grid constraints affect project returns, approvals take a long time, and resource assessment increasingly depends on data.

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent platforms become, managers still use judgment, communication, and authority to decide which land is worth securing, turn proposals into partnerships, and negotiate investments. People cannot be removed completely from development.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「政策 + 电价」——项目收益随补贴与电价走，有落地力的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大风险不是 AI，而是「政策 + 电价」——补贴退坡与并网约束影响项目收益，且审批周期长；同时资源评估越来越靠数据。

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管平台多聪明，哪块地值得拿、怎么讲成合作、投资怎么谈，最后还是经理的脑去想、嘴去说、手去签——开发这头，人撤不干净。
